court: In the High Court of Madras
advocates: For Respondents: Mr. D. Suriyanarayanan, Additional Government Pleader for R1
Mr. K. Sathish Kumar, Standing Counsel for R2
judgment_text:
The Order of the Court was delivered by

K. Ravichandrabaabu, J.:— Mr. D. Rajagopal, the learned counsel for the petitioner submitted that the prayer sought for in this writ petition has become infructuous since the respondents have issued tender form to the petitioner yesterday (03.09.2019).

2. Recording the said submission, the Writ Petition is disposed of as infructuous without expressing any view on the merits of the claim made in the Writ Petition. No costs.
